gancho: Encontró el tesoro del abuelo… un día tarde
estilo: Cinematic Mexican telenovela look, warm dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, emotional close-ups, realistic people, natural Mexican Spanish acting
escenas: Dusty attic lit by a small window that overlooks the backyard, old boxes everywhere. Characters: PAOLA (20, long braid, denim overalls), MOTHER (50, short dark hair, floral blouse). Paola opens an old wooden box and unfolds a yellowed letter, reading aloud. Paola says: "«Si estás leyendo esto, querida nieta…»"

Dusty attic lit by a small window that overlooks the backyard, old boxes everywhere. Characters: PAOLA (20, long braid, denim overalls), MOTHER (50, short dark hair, floral blouse). Paola keeps reading, her eyes widening. Paola says: "«…guardé todos mis ahorros para ti.»"

Dusty attic lit by a small window that overlooks the backyard, old boxes everywhere. Characters: PAOLA (20, long braid, denim overalls), MOTHER (50, short dark hair, floral blouse). Paola jumps up excitedly holding the letter. Paola says: "«Están enterrados bajo el naranjo del patio.» ¡No puede ser!"

Dusty attic lit by a small window that overlooks the backyard, old boxes everywhere. Characters: PAOLA (20, long braid, denim overalls), MOTHER (50, short dark hair, floral blouse). Her mother climbs up the ladder into the attic, surprised. Mother says: "¡Paola! ¿Qué haces con las cosas de tu abuelo?"

Dusty attic lit by a small window that overlooks the backyard, old boxes everywhere. Characters: PAOLA (20, long braid, denim overalls), MOTHER (50, short dark hair, floral blouse). Paola runs to her mother waving the letter. Paola says: "¡Mamá! ¡El abuelo dejó un tesoro bajo el naranjo!"

Dusty attic lit by a small window that overlooks the backyard, old boxes everywhere. Characters: PAOLA (20, long braid, denim overalls), MOTHER (50, short dark hair, floral blouse). The mother reads the letter, goes pale and sits slowly on a box. Mother says: "Ay, no… el naranjo…"

Dusty attic lit by a small window that overlooks the backyard, old boxes everywhere. Characters: PAOLA (20, long braid, denim overalls), MOTHER (50, short dark hair, floral blouse). The mother looks up at Paola with guilt. Mother says: "Tu papá lo cortó ayer… para hacer la cochera."

Dusty attic lit by a small window that overlooks the backyard, old boxes everywhere. Characters: PAOLA (20, long braid, denim overalls), MOTHER (50, short dark hair, floral blouse). Both look out the small window: below, a fresh concrete slab with a car parked on it. Paola says: "Mamá… ¿cuánto cuesta romper una cochera?"
